newsitem.title: UK: BT in strategic tie-up with Austria's PTA.
newsitem.headline: BT in strategic tie-up with Austria's PTA.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said on Thursday it had agreed a global strategic partnership with Austria's PTA.
Under the terms of the deal, Post and Telekom Austria will distribute Concert Communications Services -- the joint venture between BT and U.S. group MCI Communications Corp, BT said in a statement.
Concert aims to offer a full range of communications facilities to multinational companies.

"BT has demonstrated unparalleled success in operating in the world's most liberalised telecommunications market. We look forward to reaping the benefits of their experience as the Austrian market prepares for liberalisation," Josef Sindelka, general director of PTA, said in the statement.
BT said the Concert network was now available in about 750 cities in 49 countries worldwide.
